content.overview: Section 195, which prohibited insider trading in the Companies Act, was omitted. The current prohibition is section 12A of the SEBI Act and the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: Do not plead s. 195 as a live offence. Unpublished price-sensitive information, insider, trading window and disclosure duties are in the SEBI regulations for listed and proposed-to-be-listed securities. Criminal and civil consequences follow the SEBI Act.
